visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit living room, a man in a grey shirt and a woman in a white t-shirt stand behind a table. The woman crosses her arms while the man gestures toward a collection of items: a small blue toy, three cups of tea, and several skincare bottles. (2) Close-up shots focus on the items on the white table, including white cups with blue cloud-patterned lids and various tubes of cream. The lighting is flat and even. (3) A hand enters the frame holding banknotes, while the man points vigorously at the beverage cups and the woman holds the small blue monster figure. (4) The scene shifts to the exterior of a retail store named 'Dollarstar' with green signage. Three people are seen walking through the glass entrance. (5) Inside the store, the camera pans across shelves filled with cosmetics, eyebrows pencils, and household items. Bright pink and green price tags showing '$39' are prominently displayed on every shelf. (6) The characters are shown browsing the aisles, picking up items and expressing exaggerated surprise with wide eyes. (7) A split-screen montage shows hands squeezing white cream from a red tube and a woman in a pink headband washing her face in a white-tiled bathroom. (8) The final scene features the three main characters sitting on a grey sofa, wearing colorful headbands and facial masks. They smile and give thumbs-up gestures toward the camera while skincare products are arranged on the table in front of them.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 3 main creators (1 male, 2 female), 1 store clerk, and 1-2 distant shoppers.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: One male with short brown hair wearing a grey button-up over a white tee; two females, one with long brownish hair in a white shirt and black skirt, and another with long black hair appearing later in a beige dress.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A domestic living room with a grey sofa and white table; a bright 'Dollarstar' retail store with green branding and organized product shelves; a standard white-tiled bathroom with a chrome faucet.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with high-energy verbal exchanges between male and female voices. The speech is rapid with high pitch variability, set against a bright, percussive electronic pop beat. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect occurs repeatedly as specific items are pointed out, emphasizing key information. (3) A digital 'whoosh' transition sound effects the shift from the room to the store. (4) The narration continues with an enthusiastic, professional tone describing store features. The BGM maintains a steady 124 BPM tempo with synthetic textures. (5) A distinct mechanical 'ping' of a desk bell is heard during the store checkout scene. (6) Ambient room tone is replaced by cleaner, studio-style narration during the product demonstration phase. (7) The track concludes with all three voices shouting in unison, accompanied by a final musical stinger and a playful 'boing' cartoon sound effect.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Challenge -> Reveal/Discovery -> Demonstration -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional endorsement for the retail store 'Dollarstar' and the 'b.pure' skincare line. It uses a price-guessing challenge to hook viewers, then reveals that high-quality skincare and makeup products are available for a very low flat price of $39, demonstrating their effectiveness and safety standards.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct store visit, clear brand logos for Dollarstar and b.pure, price focus, and a final group call to visit the store.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively utilizes social media editing trends, including fast cuts, vibrant text overlays, and humor, to appeal to a younger Taiwanese audience seeking high CP-value (cost-performance) retail options.
